title: Potential energy of a spring (বিভব শক্তি)
placement: Book page 106, topic 4.3.2: বিভব শক্তি (Potential Energy). Next to চিত্র ৪.০২ (the spring at rest and squeezed by a finger) and the box V = ½kx² at the top of page 107.
description: Interactive 3D figure for textbook topic 4.3.2 (বিভব শক্তি, Potential Energy), page 106, with the box V = ½kx² on page 107. A magenta coil spring (a real helix whose coils spread and bunch) is screwed to a wall board on a wooden bench; a realistic hand holds the wooden handle at its free end. The student drags the handle (or taps steppers, or the big button's three steps: pull 5 cm, twice as far, now push in) to stretch or compress it by x, read on a centimetre ruler against the dashed x = 0 line, with an orange x bracket. The hand's force F_P and the spring's force F_S are drawn equal and opposite, to scale with F = kx, and F_S always points back toward x = 0. The panel works out F = kx in N and the book's V = ½kx² in J live (k 100–400 N/m, x up to 10 cm) and compares: twice x, twice the force, four times the energy. Five tap questions: the direction of F_S, F and V from the ruler, x doubled or tripled, stretched versus squeezed. The bench, wall, spring, handle and hand export as GLB in metres. Offline, in Bangla and English.
